# Nemours KidsHealth

> The web's most visited physician-reviewed resource for evidence-based children's health information, parenting guidance, and family wellness across the lifespan from pregnancy through teen years.

Nemours KidsHealth provides trusted, doctor-reviewed content on pediatric health conditions, child development, nutrition, safety, and parenting strategies. The site serves English and Spanish-speaking audiences with comprehensive health education and medical reference materials.

## Key Topics

- Child Health & Development
- Parenting Guidance
- Pediatric Conditions
- ADHD
- Asthma
- Allergies
- Infections & Illness
- Nutrition & Fitness
- Mental Health & Behavior
- First Aid & Safety
- Pregnancy & Newborn Care
- Medical Reference
- Preventive Care
- School & Learning
- Emotional Wellness

## Parent Resources & Hubs

- [Parents](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents): Main parents hub: child health, behavior, growth advice from birth through teen years
- [Health Topics for Parents](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/all-categories.html): Directory of doctor-reviewed health topics and articles for family care
- [Wellness Centers](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/centers/center.html): Wellness centers covering asthma, allergies, cancer, and other pediatric health conditions
- [Milestones Newsletter](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/milestones-newsletter.html): Newsletter signup for age-customized pregnancy, baby development, and parental health content

## Health Conditions & Medical Reference

- [Diseases & Conditions](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/medical): Indexed reference for pediatric diseases and conditions including asthma, allergies, diabetes
- [Infections](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/infections): Reference guide to common and uncommon pediatric infections and symptom recognition
- [General Health](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/general): Guide to common pediatric conditions, illnesses, injuries, and body basics for parents

## Child Development & Parenting Guidance

- [Growth & Development](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/growth): Comprehensive guide to child development milestones from infancy through teen years
- [Pregnancy & Baby](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/pregnancy-newborn): Pregnancy and newborn care guide covering prenatal health, labor, babyproofing, and coping
- [Emotions & Behavior](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/emotions): Guide to child emotional development, behavioral issues, ADHD, and mental health support
- [School & Family Life](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/positive): School, reading, learning disabilities, bullying, and tough parenting conversation guidance

## Wellness, Nutrition & Safety

- [Nutrition & Fitness](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/nutrition-center): Nutrition and fitness guide for kids including meal planning, picky eaters, and activity
- [First Aid & Safety](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/firstaid-safe): First aid, child safety, emergency response, home safety, and accident prevention guide

## Medical Care & Healthcare Navigation

- [Doctors & Hospitals](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/system): Guide to pediatric care, doctor visits, tests, surgery, insurance, and medical procedures

## Learning & Support Resources

- [KidsHealth Videos](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/videos): Video library on health conditions, medical procedures, baby care, and wellness topics
- [Q&A](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/question): Medical expert Q&A on parenting, diseases, body basics, and child health questions

## Spanish Language & Kids Resources

- [Parents (Spanish)](https://kidshealth.org/es/parents): Spanish-language parents section with child health, vaccines, and parenting guidance
- [Kids (Spanish)](https://kidshealth.org/es/kids): Spanish-language kids section on body functions, wellness, and health education

## Optional

- [Nemours KidsHealth Celebrates 30 Years!](https://kidshealth.org/en/parents/celebrating-30-years.html): Milestone celebration page highlighting KidsHealth's 30-year history and legacy
